notes: TADAM is a growth projection system derived from/based on TASS; a deterministic model that smooths out irregularities from TASS simulations, facilitating optimization studies. Developed by Oscar Garcia (individual author; no developer organization named in the extract). Exists for planted coastal Douglas-fir (Pseudotsuga menziesii var. menziesii), interior lodgepole pine (Pinus contorta var. latifolia) and white spruce (Picea glauca or P. glauca x engelmannii). Projects stand development from any initial conditions subject to any combination of thinnings; useful for projecting existing stands and investigating tending regimes. Its relative simplicity allows embedding into landscape-level planning models and other decision support systems. Implemented as a C function library, an interactive PDA simulator, and an Excel spreadsheet add-in. Specific output variables are not enumerated in the extract.
